## General Summary

This document is **Proposed City Ordinance No. 04-2026** from the City of Malolos, authored by Mayor Hon. Luis Alfonso M. Arcega. The ordinance establishes the **Local Housing Board** of the City of Malolos, defining its composition, powers, and functions. Its primary purpose is to formalize the municipal housing authority by creating a dedicated board responsible for overseeing housing matters, including the management of evictions and demolitions. The ordinance amends Sections 2 and 4 of City Ordinance No. 13-46-2022 and outlines specific responsibilities such as monitoring evictions and demolitions, requiring compliance checklists and certificates, and ensuring proper consultation and resettlement procedures.

## Page Range Breakdown

### Pages 1-3
These pages introduce the Proposed City Ordinance No. 04-2026 and detail the establishment of the Local Housing Board. **Page 1** provides the ordinance's metadata: it was authored by Mayor Hon. Luis Alfonso M. Arcega on Ika-03, 2026, and seeks to amend City Ordinance No. 13-46-2022 to establish the Local Housing Board. **Page 2** elaborates on the Board's composition, specifying that it includes a Chairman, representatives from the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor, members of accredited People's Organizations, and representatives of SEC-registered Non-Governmental Organizations. It also defines expanded powers, particularly regarding the monitoring of evictions and demolitions. **Page 3** presents the formal resolution text, recommending the approval of the ordinance, convening the council, and implementing the new housing governance structure. Together, these pages constitute a comprehensive proposal to create and empower the Local Housing Board as a formal municipal body.
